title: The inverse of an exact equivalence is exact
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category], and let $E:\mathcal C\simeq\mathcal D$ be an equivalence of their underlying categories. Equip $E$ with natural integer-shift comparisons making its forward functor exact. Equip its inverse with the shift comparisons induced by the equivalence adjunction, so that the unit and counit commute with shifts. Then the inverse functor $E^{-1}:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ is exact: it takes distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles.

source.place: Tag 05SQ, lemma-exact-equivalence: reflection of distinguished triangles by a fully faithful exact functor; Mathlib CategoryTheory/Triangulated/Adjunction.lean, Equivalence.IsTriangulated.mk' and inverse instance
